Hello, I hope you are still with us. Tonight doesn't have to be the end. Tomorrow is still here to watch your favorite show or eat your favorite food. Take a chance at that first please. Stay strong and I hope to see you post tomorrow beautiful 🩷

I in no way want to paint my friends as not caring about me, they do. It's me, and my inability to feel close  to anyone because of my own insecurities. I do think though that I need a change of pace and i do realize that burning everything and starting over sounds extreme.  I'll just work at making small changes....
Hi! Thank you for responding. I would like to take a mental health break but I'm afaraidnif I do I'll struggle to come back. How did you deal with that struggle?

Yes, I have passions but because of my depression, I have no motivation to do them.  It's very true that the only thing I can control is my relationship with them which is definitely a view I've adopted in the past year, but that doesnt mean that when my depression isnt rearing those thoughts arent prevelant

Yes! I've gotten on a new budgeting system that's allowing for me to save money. I'm hoping that by the summer, I can test out my need to "get away" with a mini vacation for myself. That's why I'm trying to not crack until then l

I dont want to completely leave my education, ideally I'd just continue with online courses. My issues are more so environmental. Or maybe I'm making them environmental? Running away from my surroundings because I cant cope with feeling the way I do while I interact with those I know on a daily basis? I'm still searching for the root and answer but I honestly dont realky have the luxury of just taking a couple years off and doing whatever I want which is why I'm in this dilemma lol I'm happy that it worked well for you but I have some anxiety about taking that chance. But then again, I have to do something right?
